name: Personal AI Engineering Assistant
description: A production-grade, extensible developer assistant built iteratively over 16 weeks — evolving from a basic LLM API wrapper to an autonomous, observability-instrumented, containerized cloud application.
safetyNote: Start read-only. No arbitrary shell commands or access to secrets without explicit human approval. Every tool the agent calls must be pre-approved.

stages.title: Core LLM API, Structured Output & Full-Stack UI
stages.description: Establish the foundational architecture: type-safe OpenAI/Anthropic SDK integrations, Pydantic structured output models, FastAPI backend endpoints, and interactive Streamlit frontend.
features: Model client wrapper with exponential backoff and timeout handling
Type-safe Pydantic response models for zero-shot structured analysis
FastAPI service exposing /api/chat and /api/analyze endpoints
Streamlit chat interface with multi-turn conversation memory
Automated pytest test suite with mock API fixtures

checklist.label: README with local setup and architecture overview
3+ automated tests passing with zero network calls
Pydantic structured output schemas implemented and validated
Environment variable isolation (.env.example, no hardcoded keys)

stages.title: AI-Assisted Engineering, Comprehension & Code Review
stages.description: Transform the assistant into a developer co-pilot: repository topology analysis, code explanation engine, automated PR review assistance, and pre-commit security enforcement.
features: Repository code explanation endpoint (/api/explain-code) with Mermaid diagrams
Automated Code Review helper evaluating diffs against security and performance rubrics
Semantic Git commit and pull request description generation tool
Pre-commit hook suite with ruff linting and detect-secrets scanning
Test suite expanded to 10+ comprehensive unit and integration tests

checklist.label: Automated code review checklist and rubric implemented
Pre-commit hooks (ruff + secret detection) running on every commit
Mermaid sequence and architecture diagrams documented in repo

stages.title: Production RAG, Tool-Calling Agent & Human Approval
stages.description: Advance to agentic engineering: document RAG with vector search and source citations, autonomous tool-calling execution loop with approved tools, and human-in-the-loop approval gates.
features: Document ingestion and semantic chunking pipeline for PDFs and Markdown
Vector search engine (Chroma / Qdrant) with similarity filtering and grounding
Synthesized answers with clickable, verified source citations
Autonomous agent loop with JSON Schema tool calling and execution sandbox
Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool client integration
Human-in-the-loop approval gate for sensitive operations

checklist.label: RAG pipeline operational with strict refusal on out-of-domain queries
Responses output verifiable citation provenance for all claims
Autonomous tool calling agent with 3+ approved tools
Human approval gate successfully interrupts and resumes execution
25-task offline benchmark dataset evaluated with metrics report

stages.title: AI Security Hardening, Observability & Cloud Deployment
stages.description: Production hardening and deployment: threat model mitigations against OWASP LLM vulnerabilities, structured JSON telemetry and fallbacks, multi-stage Docker build, and live cloud deployment.
features: Prompt injection and indirect injection defense barriers with automated security tests
Least-privilege tool execution boundaries with path traversal prevention
Structured JSON logging with correlation trace IDs across all requests
Automated model fallback circuit breaker (e.g. Claude 3.5 -> GPT-4o on 5xx/429)
Rate limiting token bucket middleware and live metrics endpoint
Multi-stage Dockerfile and Docker Compose orchestration
GitHub Actions CI pipeline running lint, test, and security audit on every push
Public cloud deployment (Render / Fly.io / Railway) with live working URL

checklist.label: THREAT_MODEL.md and automated security regression tests committed
Structured logging with trace IDs and health endpoints live
Multi-stage Dockerfile built and verified under 250MB
GitHub Actions CI pipeline executing all tests green on push
Public production URL live with working full-stack demo
2-minute asynchronous Loom/OBS demo video recorded and linked in README
